title: cephalanthera longifolia f. longibracteata
intro: Cephalanthera longifolia f. longibracteata, commonly known as the long-bracted helleborine, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the orchid family. It is a perennial herb with medicinal properties that have been used to treat various health conditions. The plant is rich in flavonoids, phenolic acids, and other bioactive constituents, which have been reported to have anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial therapeutic actions. The health benefits of Cephalanthera longifolia f. longibracteata include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties, although further studies are needed to confirm these effects.
